description: Read one EVM address and return its native coin balance and up to five ERC-20 token balances on Base or Ethereum, every figure tied to the block height it was read at. Token decimals are read on-chain from the contract, not assumed, and a token whose read fails is reported as an error rather than as zero. Use it to check a wallet before paying it, to confirm funds arrived, or to size a transfer without running your own node. The caller names the ERC-20 contracts, so no token list goes stale. Input: {"address": "0x...", "chain": "base", "tokens": ["0x..."]}. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, no account, no API key). 【価格】0.00 USDC。【使い方】呼ぶと 402 と PAYMENT-REQUIRED（支払い条件）が返る。USDC で支払い、同じ引数に PAYMENT-SIGNATURE ヘッダを添えて再送すると結果が返る。

address.description: EVM address to read, 0x + 40 hex chars

tokens.description: Optional ERC-20 contract addresses (0x + 40 hex) to read balances for, max 5

name: onchain-balance
